**Finding submitted: deviation (IP — Ownership of deliverables and Customer Data).**

What I found:
- **§13 (p0088)** is the sole ownership provision. It vests in Garman "all intellectual property rights in the Work (including any Improvements or Modifications thereto), including all related materials, logos, and names provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement" — the unqualified "all related materials ... provided pursuant to the terms of this Agreement" could sweep in our own materials and the data Garman converts under **§4(b)**.
- **No Customer Data ownership statement exists anywhere** in the Agreement; our data appears only as a conversion input (§4(b)) and incidentally within Confidential Information (§14).
- The fallback is also unmet: the only licence back (**§2**) is a non-exclusive, non-transferable use licence confined to Authorized Locations and contingent on continued fee payment (§17(a)), with no modify or sublicence rights and no express coverage of the Schedule "D" Modifications we fund.

Redline (validated, ok:true): qualified Garman's ownership to materials *it* provides, added a sentence confirming we retain all right, title and interest in our data and materials with no assignment to Garman, and added a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to the Modifications and customisations we pay for. I did not seek assignment of the Modifications, given the packaged-software bargain and the §16 source code arrangements.
